user.title: Add DHL Packstation
user.description: Shows available locker compartments by size (S, M, L, XL) and total. Updates every 15 minutes. Enter the station's Postfinder ID, for example 1-23611202. This unofficial integration reads DHL's undocumented endpoint without an account or API key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read live compartment data. Check the ID and try again.
